title: Here's Why You Shouldn't Run From The Police #3
description:
On May 22, 2021, an officer spotted a vehicle driving recklessly in Pleasant Prairie, WI. When he initiated a traffic stop, the vehicle fled at a high rate of speed, ran a red light, and struck another vehicle.

transcript.text: 22nd, 2021, an officer was conducting traffic enforcement in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin, when he saw a vehicle driving recklessly. When the officer activated their lights to initiate a traffic stop on the vehicle, the driver abruptly stopped and then fled at a high rate of speed. The officer pursued the recklessly fleeing vehicle until it struck an uninvolved motorist at an intersection. 1050, 1050, I got one car on fire. The male driver of the fleeing vehicle was the sole occupant and sustained severe injuries in the crash. He was transported to an area hospital via Flight for Life.
